visitors: Exact original far visitor sequence reused after t200; no new visitor histories.
future_fixed_assurance: Clamps expressed A at 0.5 and disables A mutation, preserving source A allele diversity latent; not retroactive deletion of A alleles.
future_evolvable_assurance: Original expressed A and A mutation allowed with same source reproduction/inheritance kernel.
primary_estimands: Within each t200 source population, I(t1000)-I(t200) in future A evolvable minus fixed, matched on history and RNG
Contrast of this future-policy effect between the two different t200 source-genotype origins
secondary_estimands: Initial-origin-state difference within each same future policy, descriptive conditional on post-treatment states
Year-by-year mean I, expected one-step Price I and realized I changes
N, extinct/missing terminal trait, zero visitor exposure, realized parentage, genotype support
decision_rules: Do not drop extinct cells to compute I means; report occupancy and declare trait contrast undefined when required
No significance claim from one-history technical pilot; use all 64 visitor histories as inferential clusters for exploratory full readout
A replicated opposite-sign divergence across the origin×future-policy cells would support a history-dependent mechanism only conditionally, not natural-causal mediation
If all four t200 starts under same future policy converge regardless of genetic origin, the simple lasting-genotype-history hypothesis weakens
If future-policy effect within identical t200 origin is essentially zero, future A evolution after t200 does not explain a large conditional component
Preserve null/negative/mixed results and fixed original endpoints
limits: Source checkpoints store alleles and traces but not authentic original ID/age/ancestry/parentage at t200; new descendant parentage is simulated after t200 only.
The case is conditional on previously evolved different t200 genotype states; does not randomize past treatment histories.
New independently seeded future demographic streams deliberately do not reproduce the frozen original t200→t1000 trajectories.
Differences may reflect stochastic lineage composition, nonlinear feedback, genetic access, or bounds; no isolated pure-drift fraction.
Near arm and wild islands are not tested in this mechanistic pilot; the original near and far both had pollen limitation.

primary_postpilot_cohort.scope: The source-selected visitor histories and first seed pilot are known; remaining 63 conditional continuation futures were not inspected at protocol amendment. Descriptive model-specific checks, NOT independent prospective ecological discovery.

holdout_descriptive_statistics.per_mating_setting: 64-history reference and pre-pilot-unseen 63-history primary descriptive set
holdout_descriptive_statistics.unit: original external visitor history, one t200 original demographic repeat per visitor history
holdout_descriptive_statistics.family: 2x2 difference in future I change from t200; other contrasts secondary
holdout_descriptive_statistics.extinction: if any 2x2 cell extinct, do not calculate an unconditional mean I contrast; retain occupancy and undefined history IDs
holdout_descriptive_statistics.outcome_readout: All signs, including failure to preserve I, plus paired four-cell per-history outcomes; no posthoc success criterion

null_predictions: A future policy within identical t200 genotype origin produces negligible mean I change by t1000: no subsequent assurance-mediated effect detected
Origin-dependent final I differences disappear after subtracting t200 baseline under common future policies: no retained path dependence in conditional I change
Conditional future policy effects remain near zero despite original 1000-step far E-F endpoint being positive: original difference may have arisen before t200
Signs reverse across settings or histories: report heterogeneity and reject any universal one-sign mechanism
Zero-visitor selection gradient is -2*cI*I, not zero; no-pollen histories alone cannot establish cessation of selection
